name: Kadiatou Reyes-Abubakar
role: High-risk package and data transport — courier
location: Old Harbor — repurposed shipping infrastructure turned black market hub, near Michigan Ave South and Cermak
description:
Kadiatou Reyes-Abubakar are broad-shouldered and heavy, carrying their weight like armor rather than burden. At 44, they have soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate them once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — dermal camouflage — chromatic skin pigment cells, limited active camouflage — and they make no effort to hide it.

They used to be somebody else, in another city, with another name — that person is officially dead, and Kadiatou Reyes-Abubakar plans to keep it that way. They work as a courier out of Old Harbor, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

Kadiatou Reyes-Abubakar are the kind of runner other runners tell stories about, though the stories vary depending on who they burned last.

core_fears: Betrayal by someone they trust — the only currency that matters
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
Their past catching up — debts, enemies, broken promises
core_desires: Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
coping_mechanisms: Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
blind_spots: Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
psychology.secret: Kadiatou Reyes-Abubakar murdered their mentor to take their position and contacts. It was staged as a job gone wrong. The guilt has calcified into something worse than guilt.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Educated vocabulary wrapped in street delivery — the contrast is deliberate.
speech_patterns.cadence: Flowing and unhurried — talks like someone who has never been interrupted and doesn't expect to be.
verbal_tics: Swears in three languages, often in the same sentence
Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
example_lines: "I don't look inside the package. I don't ask about the package. I deliver the package."
"Speed is a skill. Knowing when to slow down is wisdom. I sell both."
"This route has three checkpoints and a kill zone. I'll be there in twenty minutes."

story_hooks: A dead drop Kadiatou Reyes-Abubakar maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
Kadiatou Reyes-Abubakar is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
Kadiatou Reyes-Abubakar discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
narrative_function: Kadiatou Reyes-Abubakar functions as a connector — their work puts them in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving them naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Dermal camouflage — chromatic skin pigment cells, limited active camouflage. Synthetic blood with oxygen-carrying nanites — doesn't tire, heals faster
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.

strengths: social chameleon — adapts to any environment
weaknesses: risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities
old injury that flares under specific conditions

decision_rules: Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
breaking_points: Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture

physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and heavy-set, muscular through the core and legs with density that reads as functional rather than aesthetic. Carries their mass with deliberate control — the bearing of someone who has learned their body is a tool and a weapon.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with silver-grey threading at temples and crown
physical_description.hair_style: Kept short, close to the scalp, practical and low-maintenance. Styled with precision despite the nocturnal lifestyle.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, almost black, with faint iridescence from subcutaneous neural enhancement
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium-deep brown with warm undertones, complexion marked by the chromatic sheen of dermal camouflage cells
physical_description.complexion: Face is broad and symmetrical with soft features that contrast sharply with their physical presence — high cheekbones, full lips, a wide mouth that rarely smiles. Skin surface has an unusual luminescence in low light, subtle color-shifting in the epidermis. No facial hair. Nocturnal pallor evident beneath the melanin — minimal sun exposure over years.
distinguishing_marks: Vertical scar along left jawline, approximately 8cm, pale silver against darker skin — clean cut, old, professionally healed
Network of faint linear scars across both shoulders in a pattern suggesting blade work or shrapnel, barely visible unless light catches them at specific angles
Burn scar on right forearm (inner wrist to elbow), textured and pink, roughly 12cm long — old but not as old as the jawline scar

Chromatic pigmentation pattern across upper chest and collarbone area where the dermal camouflage is densest, creating a subtle iridescent sheen that shifts from copper to violet depending on light and angle
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Dermal camouflage cells create a distinctive luminescent quality to the skin, particularly visible on the upper body, neck, and face. The effect is subtle in bright light but unmistakable in shadows — skin appears to absorb and shift color minutely. The chromatic effect becomes pronounced under LED or neon lighting. No visible mechanical augmentations — the synthetic blood system and oxygen-carrying nanites are entirely subcutaneous.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with controlled weight, economical gestures. Never fidgets. Walks like someone counting exits and calculating trajectories. When seated, occupies space deliberately — shoulders back, spine straight. In conversation, maintains stillness until necessary movement. Eyes track constantly, a habit of someone whose survival has depended on noticing what others miss. Despite the heavy build, movement is fluid rather than ponderous.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-3 utilitarian noir — form-fitted tactile bodysuit in matte black synthweave with integrated cable routing and reinforced stress points. Over this, a loose-cut long coat in charcoal grey synthetic leather, oversized to accommodate gear and conceal the bulk of the augmentations, hits mid-thigh. Flat-soled tactical boots in unmarked black, practical for running and climbing. Minimal jewelry — a silver band on right middle finger, possibly a keepsake from a previous life. No logos or branding. Clothing is maintained obsessively, replacing pieces the moment they show wear. The overall aesthetic reads as someone who is not trying to be invisible, but is trying very hard not to be memorable.
